title: Amnon and Tamar
lead: David's firstborn son Amnon raped his half-sister Tamar and then threw her out; her full brother Absalom killed him two years later (2 Samuel 13). The story echoes Dinah's (Genesis 34) and begins the violence within David's family that Nathan foretold. (Not to be confused with Judah's daughter-in-law Tamar, Genesis 38.)
